title: Foldable Paper Plane Distance Search
description: Search a reproducible parametric A4 fold construction and launch conditions for maximum simulated horizontal distance.

construction.material_budget: keel + wing use the same A4 half-sheet width
construction.fold_plan: generated from the winning candidate and embedded in visualization.data

fold_plan.coordinate_system: x across sheet from center crease, y nose-to-tail

creases.label: Center crease
creases.instruction: Fold the right half onto the left half, crease, then reopen.

creases.label: Left nose fold
creases.instruction: Bring the left nose corner inward toward the center crease.

creases.label: Right nose fold
creases.instruction: Bring the right nose corner inward toward the center crease.

creases.label: Left shoulder fold
creases.instruction: Fold the left shoulder flap inward toward the center body.

creases.label: Right shoulder fold
creases.instruction: Fold the right shoulder flap inward toward the center body.

creases.label: Left wing fold
creases.instruction: With the model folded on the center crease, fold the left wing down along this swept crease.

creases.label: Right wing fold
creases.instruction: Fold the right wing down symmetrically along this swept crease.

creases.label: Left tip fold
creases.instruction: Deflect the left tip by approximately -5.5 degrees.

creases.label: Right tip fold
creases.instruction: Deflect the right tip symmetrically by approximately -5.5 degrees.

creases.label: Left elevator fold
creases.instruction: Set the left trailing elevator to approximately -7.7 degrees.

creases.label: Right elevator fold
creases.instruction: Set the right trailing elevator symmetrically to approximately -7.7 degrees.

steps.title: Center crease
steps.instruction: Fold the right half onto the left half along the center line, make the crease, then reopen.

steps.title: Nose
steps.instruction: Bring both nose corners inward symmetrically to the searched nose depth and width.

steps.title: Shoulders
steps.instruction: Fold both shoulder flaps inward symmetrically using the searched shoulder crease.

steps.title: Body and wings
steps.instruction: Fold the model in half on the center crease, then fold both outer wings down along the searched swept wing creases.

steps.title: Tips
steps.instruction: Adjust both wing tips symmetrically to approximately -5.5 degrees.

steps.title: Elevators and dihedral
steps.instruction: Set both elevators to approximately -7.7 degrees, then open the wings to approximately 10.2 degrees dihedral.

fold_plan.note: Reproducible approximation of the searched uncut-A4 fold-envelope; paper thickness and layer contact are not simulated.
